# Release Notes: April 2, 2026

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience.



## Fix

### *Fixed Providers Not Found in few Zip Codes for Compare Networks Module*

Resolved an issue in Compare Networks where networks and providers were not displayed for certain ZIP codes entered in 5-digit format. Users can now successfully find and view providers in the Compare Networks report for the affected ZIP codes.
